Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

weather — the state of the air outside. Example: What is the weather like?
sunny — with a lot of sun. Example: Tomorrow it is sunny.
rain — water falling from the sky. Example: It is going to rain.
snow — soft white ice falling from the sky. Example: On Saturday it is going to snow.
cold — with a low temperature. Example: It is cold in winter.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Tomorrow it is sunny.
• It is going to rain.
• Let's go to the park.
• The forecast is good.
• It is going to snow.
